target.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage
target.body:
### Description
This PR resolves the issue where Antigravity's exhausted 5-hour quota reset time was hidden when the weekly quota still had remaining capacity.

### Changes
- **Sources/CodexBar/MenuBarMetricWindowResolver.swift**: Removed the `usedPercent < 100` filtering logic for Antigravity's `mostConstrainedAntigravityQuotaSummaryWindow` and `mostConstrainedAntigravityLegacyExtraWindow` so that 100% used rate windows are correctly selected.
- **Sources/CodexBar/UsageStore+HighestUsage.swift**: Removed the `usedPercent < 100` filtering in `mostConstrainedAntigravityQuotaSummaryWindow` so that it doesn't fall back to weekly quota percent when session is exhausted. Also fixed `shouldExcludeFromHighestUsage` to check `snapshot.extraRateWindows` to prevent false exclusion of Antigravity from the highest usage ranking when only one model family is exhausted.
- **Tests/CodexBarTests/MenuBarMetricWindowResolverTests.swift**: Updated expectations to prioritize 100% used windows.
- **Tests/CodexBarTests/UsageStoreHighestUsageTests.swift**: Updated expectations to prioritize 100% used windows.

### Verification
- All tests in `MenuBarMetricWindowResolverTests` and `UsageStoreHighestUsageTests` compile and pass.
